avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer that significantly reduces rucaparib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if discontinuation of St. John's Wort is necessary, allow 2 weeks washout before assessment of rucaparib dosing adjustments

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin K supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase thrombotic risk; rucaparib can cause thrombocytopenia and bleeding complications
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose supplementation; maintain consistent dietary intake and monitor platelet counts regularly

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor that may modestly increase rucaparib concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; counsel on consistent use patterns if tolerated

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May affect gut microbiome and drug absorption; generally supportive for GI tolerability
caution_supplements.action: Safe to use; may help manage GI side effects from rucaparib therapy

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases rucaparib plasma concentrations, elevating risk of dose-related toxicity
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance recommended; select alternative citrus fruits (oranges, lemons, limes)

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay rucaparib absorption and alter bioavailability kinetics
caution_foods.action: Take rucaparib consistently with or without food; establish routine to minimize variability

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cabbage, Brussels sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contain compounds that may induce CYP3A4; unlikely to be clinically significant at dietary levels
caution_foods.action: No restriction needed; maintain balanced diet and monitor clinical response

monitoring_notes: Monitor platelet counts, hemoglobin, and renal function regularly as rucaparib carries significant hematologic and hepatic toxicity risks. Educate patients on bleeding precautions, report signs of anemia/infection, and maintain consistent supplement/food intake patterns to avoid pharmacokinetic variability.
